title: Business Central Launch Event 2024 Release Wave 2 - Recording of Live Opening

chapters.title: Copilot for Finance and Item Management
Partner Access Control and Admin Audit Logging
AL-Go for GitHub and AL Language Improvements
Code Navigation and AI Toolkit for Copilot Development
AI Testing and Managed AI Resources

features.name: Copilot enabled by default
features.description: Copilot is now default on without requiring setup, with an admin page to control which capabilities are enabled or disabled in the company.

features.name: Copilot Chat for data inquiries
features.description: Chat feature that helps users query data by generating analysis views linked to analysis tabs, and can work with current pages like customer or item lists.

features.name: Copilot Chat multilingual support
features.description: Chat with copilot is now available in 20 additional languages, enabling users to interact and build analysis views in their own language.
features.status_evidence_quote: adding 20 languages with this release it's now available in all these languages

features.name: Copilot for Finance app
features.description: Separate Microsoft app focused on finance scenarios, helping collection teams respond to and summarize emails, handle disputes and dispute status, and synchronize payment promise dates back to Business Central.
caveats: More capabilities coming from the finance team

features.name: Copilot item substitution generation
features.description: When creating a new item, users can select substitutions and click generate to have copilot suggest other cheap items, saving time on item setup.
caveats: Also available for Dimensions, unit of measure, and variance

features.name: Copilot number series generation
features.description: MVP contribution allowing copilot to automatically suggest and generate number series setup when starting with a blank number series, including names and starting numbers.

features.name: Subscription billing
features.description: New capability area for setting up service contracts, billing periods, and revenue recognition for subscriptions, including handling subscriptions that cross fiscal year boundaries.

features.name: Power BI reports expansion
features.description: 70+ new Power BI reports covering all business areas including manufacturing expansion, available for viewing analytics and business metrics like income and profit.
caveats: More areas like manufacturing being explored for future additions

features.name: Financial reports and definitions
features.description: 12 additional financial reports with expanded row and column definitions that users can select and customize to build their own financial reports.

features.name: Sustainability tracking module
features.description: Rich sustainability tracking module for recording greenhouse gases, carbon credits, with row centers, scorecards, and goals to help meet government reporting requirements.

features.name: Project and Service management improvements
features.description: Extended capabilities in projects and service management including extended text archiving based on customer feedback and needs from other product areas.

features.name: Shopify integration improvements
features.description: Continued improvements to Shopify integration with faster sales cycles, supporting the 2.5 million active Shopify shops in the market with better e-commerce integration.
caveats: Ongoing improvements as Shopify adds new features

features.name: Frontline workers integration with Dynamics 365 Field Service
features.description: Integration with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Field Service for service orders, providing both back office and front office capabilities for businesses doing service work with frontline workers.
caveats: Started in last release with projects

features.name: Power BI embedded in Business Central
features.description: Power BI reports are now embedded directly in Business Central, allowing users to work with rich reports without leaving the product.

features.name: Power Automate integration improvements
features.description: Continued improvements to power automate integration for building flows and workflows for any business process inside Business Central.

features.name: Job queue notifications via Power Automate
features.description: Users can now receive job queue notifications when there are challenges and build flows to send notifications to the right users in the company.

features.name: Keyboard access keys in multiple languages
features.description: French access keys are now available in all supported languages in this release, enabling keyboard-productive users to work in their preferred language.

features.name: Modern search in preview
features.description: New modern search capability in preview using full-text search in partner-marked columns, offering faster performance with character matching compared to legacy search.
features.status_evidence_quote: it's in preview uh right now in this month it will come out uh in next month
caveats: Will come out of preview next month
Legacy search still available for comprehensive searching

features.name: Column resizing without personalization
features.description: Users can now resize columns in the moment on the current screen without entering personalization mode. Previously, column resizing required personalization and affected all devices.

features.name: Word reporting conditional formatting
features.description: Word document reports in Business Central now support conditional formatting. Users can hide fields based on conditions and switch between different word layouts for richer reporting experiences.

features.name: Community contributions
features.description: 156 community contributions were included in this release across connectors, horizontal capabilities, business features, sensibility events, bug fixes, and AI and copilot features.

features.name: Flexible update management
features.description: Administrators can now postpone updates for a longer period. The scheduling window extends from 60 days to 5 months, allowing customers to find the right moment to apply updates while maintaining solution compatibility.
features.status_evidence_quote: this capability is coming out in preview and what is it this is ability for the administrators to postpone the updates
caveats: Microsoft encourages staying on latest versions

features.name: Partner access assignment to specific environments
features.description: Administrators can now assign partners to specific environments in the tenant admin center. Delegated admins will only have access to the assigned environment, useful when working across multiple environments in different countries.

features.name: Administrative audit logging to Microsoft 365
features.description: All administrative requests and actions performed in the admin center and application are now logged to Microsoft 365 unified audit log. Business Central is now part of the Microsoft auditing solution portfolio.

features.name: AL-Go for GitHub security hardening
features.description: AL-Go for GitHub has been enhanced with security hardening, allowing users to run pipelines more securely and operate in a more protected environment.

features.name: AL-Go ISV app compatibility testing
features.description: AL-Go for GitHub now enables easy testing of solution compatibility with all dependent ISV apps. If ISVs plug into the system and share symbols, developers can test compatibility with current and future versions any time.

features.name: AL-Go performance baseline testing
features.description: AL-Go for GitHub enables setting up environments to create baselines for performance tests. Developers can run tests to measure current performance and use it as a baseline for future changes to track performance impact.

features.name: AL interface improvements
features.description: AL language and Visual Studio Code development environment have received multiple improvements. Interface improvements make building extensible solutions easier.

features.name: Query object save as JSON
features.description: Support for save as JSON on the query object has been added to AL language development environment.

features.name: Page extension settings modifications
features.description: Capabilities to modify and update settings for page extensions allowing inserts, modifies, and deletes have been added to AL language.

features.name: Code navigation with GitHub integration
features.description: Consultants and power users can navigate from the Business Central UI to code behind pages. The flow can now open in Visual Studio Code to interact with GitHub repositories, ensuring code is current and safely saved.

features.name: AI toolkit for copilot development
features.description: AI toolkit is a development tool for partners and ISVs to design AI-infused scenarios in Business Central. It includes samples, code, and a prompt dialogue with built-in capabilities.

features.name: Copilot actions on more pages
features.description: Copilot actions are now available on many more pages, allowing developers to infuse them into other elements of Business Central.

features.name: Prompt dialogue error messages in UI
features.description: The prompt dialogue can now surface messages and error messages from code directly into the UI of the prompt dialogue, eliminating annoying popups and providing a user-friendly experience.

features.name: AI usage telemetry for ISVs and partners
features.description: Partners and ISVs can now emit and monitor telemetry for AI usage to understand how customers are using AI features in their solutions, with no customer data included.

features.name: AI testing toolkit for copilot solutions
features.description: New testing tool for copilot builders to test AI features with test suites and data sets, designed to work with different prompts and verify expected outcomes.
features.status_evidence_quote: so please take a look at the preview which we published at aka.ms BC ups
caveats: works in combination with Azure AI Studio

features.name: Azure AI Studio integration for harm testing
features.description: Integration with Azure AI Studio to test for harm and malicious intent in AI solutions, ensuring code and prompts are ready for unwanted input.

features.name: Managed AI resources private preview
features.description: ISVs and solution providers can use Microsoft-managed AI resources instead of bringing their own Azure AI subscriptions, eliminating the need to manage AI infrastructure at scale.
features.status_evidence_quote: we are gradually coming to the place where we would like to expand this private preview into the public preview so there will definitely

features.name: Scheduled client performance profiler
features.description: Ability to schedule client performance profiler runs in the background to capture performance bottlenecks at specific times, available from the help and support page.

features.name: Modern search performance improvement
features.description: New modern search provides significant performance improvements for searching items in list pages, drill downs, and lookups, especially for large datasets with hundreds of thousands of items.

features.name: Job queue priority and execution order
features.description: Job queue execution is now guaranteed to process jobs in first-in-first-out order, and priority can be assigned through job queue categories for higher priority jobs.

features.name: Warehouse ledger entry posting pattern refactor
features.description: New pattern for posting to warehouse ledger entries that significantly reduces locking and increases concurrency, allowing much higher throughput in warehouse scenarios.

features.name: Page scripting in pipelines
features.description: Page scripting tool now supports running recorded user interface tests in CI/CD pipelines with recurrent scheduling, in addition to recording and replaying tests in the UI.
